entries.german:
Graf Rudolf von Wertheim und Rudolf von Wertheim, Domherr zu Würzburg, Gebrüder, verzichten aus Liebe zu ihrem Oheim Graf Berthold von Henneberg, Johanniter-Prior und Komtur zu Boxberg, auf alle ihre Lehnsrechte an den vom Johanniter-Orden besessenen Gütern.

Siegel des Grafen von Wertheim stark beschädigt, das des Domherrn Rudolf fehlt
entries.english:
Count Rudolf of Wertheim and Rudolf of Wertheim, Canon of Würzburg, brothers, renounce all their feudal rights to the properties owned by the Order of St. John out of love for their uncle Count Berthold of Henneberg, Prior of the Order of St. John and Commander of Boxberg.

Seal of Count of Wertheim badly damaged, that of Canon Rudolf missing
facts: Graf Berthold von Henneberg is Johanniter-Prior and Komtur zu Boxberg
Johanniter Order possessed goods at Boxberg by 1321
Boxberg served as a Johanniter commandery under Henneberg leadership
Wertheim family had feudal rights over Johanniter goods at Boxberg (renounced in favor of Henneberg)
